_what: Hash history of every PRED-001-governed file. The first entry is the v1.0 freeze (commit bc945687) and is pinned in tests/test_prediction_protocol.py. Each later entry is one dated amendment in the protocol's ## Amendments section. A file that differs from the last entry fails the test.

history.motivation: independent review commissioned by the owner, two rounds before merge: round 1 found five bypasses (B1-B5) and seven weaknesses (S1-S7); round 2 found that B1, B2 and parts of B3-B5 still worked, plus four lock-table defects; round 3 found the coverage rule failed honest cards, whole cards could be dropped, text-sorted timestamps, and int-coerced H1 facts; round 4 found two false-INVALID paths (next-card locks, 95%-per-card meaning 100%); round 5 found the one-missing-bout allowance could be gamed by rolling back the worst bout; round 6 found no blocker and one small gap (writer-controlled pricing cutoff), closed
